title: Scaling Forced Alignment to End-User Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.21145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Viterbi algorithm has been previously used to perform forced alignment of audio to text to mine training data from online resources. However, many existing implementations have quadratic time and space complexity, scaling poorly to long input sequences. We propose two optimizations to address this issue. First, we apply the Hirschberg algorithm to perform the alignment in place using linear memory. Second, we model the alignment between speech and text as a constrained random walk, allowing us to prune the search space with arbitrary confidence while accounting for transcription errors. The Hirschberg optimization reduces memory usage from 140 GB to 5 MB for three-hour inputs while producing identical alignments in one-third the time of torchaudio when both run on a CPU. We achieve an additional 2x speedup with pruning on inputs longer than 20 minutes while preserving alignment accuracy in more than 98% of tested cases.

translated_title: 将强制对齐扩展到终端用户设备
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.21145v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Viterbi算法此前已被用于执行音频与文本之间的强制对齐，以从在线资源中挖掘训练数据。然而，许多现有实现具有二次方的时间和空间复杂度，难以扩展到长输入序列。我们提出了两项优化来解决这一问题。首先，我们应用Hirschberg算法，使用线性内存就地执行对齐。其次，我们将语音与文本之间的对齐建模为受约束的随机游走，从而能够在考虑转录错误的同时，以任意置信度对搜索空间进行剪枝。Hirschberg优化将三小时输入的内存使用量从140 GB降至5 MB，并且在CPU上运行时，以torchaudio三分之一的时间产生了完全相同的对齐结果。在超过20分钟的输入上，剪枝带来了额外的2倍加速，同时在超过98%的测试案例中保持了对齐精度。
tldr: 该论文通过Hirschberg算法实现线性内存对齐以及基于受约束随机游走的搜索空间剪枝两项优化，将强制对齐的内存使用从140 GB降至5 MB并获得额外2倍加速，使长音频的强制对齐能够在终端用户设备上运行。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two optimizations—Hirschberg algorithm-based linear-memory alignment and constrained random walk-based search space pruning—that reduce memory usage from 140 GB to 5 MB and achieve an additional 2x speedup, enabling forced alignment of long audio inputs on end-user devices.
